description.zh-Hans: 政权、主权、领土与边界位置的变化。
description.en: Changes in regime, sovereignty, territory, and boundary position.

description.zh-Hans: 人口基础、城市密度与聚落网络的收缩或重组。
description.en: Contraction or reorganization of population, urban density, and settlement networks.

description.zh-Hans: 制度、教育、知识复制与专业群体的损失。
description.en: Loss in institutions, education, knowledge transmission, and professional groups.

description.zh-Hans: 交通、贸易、通信与基础设施网络的中断或退化。
description.en: Disruption or degradation of transport, trade, communication, and infrastructure.

description.zh-Hans: 宗教、文化、语言、身份与核心承载体的变化。
description.en: Changes in religion, culture, language, identity, and key carriers.

description.zh-Hans: 旧结构被吸收、转型、部分延续或压缩未来空间。
description.en: Absorption, transformation, partial continuation, or compression of future option space.

definition.zh-Hans: 政权终止描述文明在该维度上的位置变化，不等同于整体文明崩塌。

interpretation.zh-Hans: 西罗马中央政治载体终止，但罗马法律、宗教与城市遗产并未同时消失。
interpretation.en: The western Roman central political carrier ended while legal, religious, and urban legacies continued.

note.zh-Hans: 早期与长时段资料存在不确定性，图谱保留范围与未知。
note.en: Early and long-duration evidence remains uncertain; the Atlas preserves ranges and unknowns.

interpretation.zh-Hans: 苏美尔多城市政治形态被后续两河体系重组，但文字、城市与制度传统继续进入继任结构。
interpretation.en: Sumerian polycentric political forms were reorganized by later Mesopotamian systems while writing, urban, and institutional traditions continued.

note.zh-Hans: 早期与长时段资料存在不确定性，图谱保留范围与未知。
note.en: Early and long-duration evidence remains uncertain; the Atlas preserves ranges and unknowns.

interpretation.zh-Hans: 宋代政治形式结束后，商业、知识、制度与技术能力并未全部归零，而进入后续中国 Runtime。
interpretation.en: After the Song political form ended, commercial, knowledge, institutional, and technical capacities continued into successor Chinese runtimes.

note.zh-Hans: 早期与长时段资料存在不确定性，图谱保留范围与未知。
note.en: Early and long-duration evidence remains uncertain; the Atlas preserves ranges and unknowns.

interpretation.zh-Hans: 阿拔斯中央政治权力衰退后，伊斯兰知识、宗教与商业网络继续跨政治载体存在。
interpretation.en: After Abbasid central political power declined, Islamic knowledge, religious, and commercial networks continued across political carriers.

note.zh-Hans: 早期与长时段资料存在不确定性，图谱保留范围与未知。
note.en: Early and long-duration evidence remains uncertain; the Atlas preserves ranges and unknowns.

interpretation.zh-Hans: 马里政治控制与贸易中心地位发生收缩与迁移，但区域文化与伊斯兰知识网络继续。
interpretation.en: Mali's political reach and trade-center position contracted and shifted while regional culture and Islamic knowledge networks continued.

note.zh-Hans: 早期与长时段资料存在不确定性，图谱保留范围与未知。
note.en: Early and long-duration evidence remains uncertain; the Atlas preserves ranges and unknowns.

interpretation.zh-Hans: 英国工业—帝国形态后来发生大规模转型，部分制度、金融、语言与网络能力进入新的国际结构。
interpretation.en: Britain's industrial-imperial form later transformed substantially while institutional, financial, linguistic, and network capacities entered new international structures.
